source.label: Local AIT-ADS alert export

metricDefinitions.label: Alert counts
metricDefinitions.definition: Alert counts include every parseable nonempty NDJSON row in all 16 local files; Wazuh files also contain Suricata alerts.

caveats: The export contains selected detector alerts, not complete raw telemetry.
Attack labels are half-open time intervals and do not establish event-level maliciousness.

evidenceFlow.title: Recorded checks
evidenceFlow.detail: Streamed all files: 2,655,821 rows, no bad JSON or missing event times; no duplicate Wazuh event IDs within files. Local labels MD5 matches the publisher checksum.

preview.note: Counts by scenario across the full local export.

items.title: Where are the flood and evidence gaps?

source.label: Local full-file investigation

metricDefinitions.label: HTTP-error share
metricDefinitions.definition: The HTTP-error share counts Wazuh-file alerts whose rule description is Web server 400 error code., divided by all Wazuh-file alerts.

metricDefinitions.label: Phase overlap
metricDefinitions.definition: Phase overlap counts records with an event timestamp inside a labeled interval for the same scenario.

caveats: Phase overlap is not a measured attack detection rate.
Training-mode records can overlap attack intervals.
Any cross-source incident linkage is an interpretation requiring evidence review.

rows.finding: AMiner training-mode alerts inside phase intervals

preview.note: Selected findings from the full-file scan and temporal-label joins.

items.title: Which research ideas fit this dataset?
assumptions: Applying these architectures to the local export is a recommendation, not a reproduced experimental result.

source.label: From Investigation Failures to Reliable SOC Agents: Understanding and Improving LLM-Based Alert Triage

links.label: From Investigation Failures to Reliable SOC Agents: Understanding and Improving LLM-Based Alert Triage

caveats: Paper results were not reproduced on the local logs.

queries.summary: AIDA evaluates evidence-led triage on Russellmitchell and Wardbeck in the same AIT dataset family. The system starts from detector alerts and uses underlying telemetry plus event-level labels.

queries.summary: SERA-IDS retrieves structured feature rules from a library frozen at test time. Its benchmarks use numerical network flows, not this alert export.
